sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases star elemental attack by 8 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 5 for 20 seconds. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
Only [Gale Girl] Chizu can be used as Unlocking Potential material
